about.title: BASE-W (iteration 10): which weights make Qwen3-8B pick one algorithm -- demo subset
about.examples: the 20 T10 prompts; each carries both models' fork states, the captured margins and, for the 5 slot prompts (first prompt of each template), the labelled programs generated from it
about.array_encoding: {dtype, shape, b64}: little-endian raw bytes in base64; bfloat16 is stored as its uint16 bit pattern
about.exactness: fork states, rows and gains are the bf16 values the experiment used; pools, drawn tokens and deltas were checked bit-exactly against the committed null draws

readout_decomposition_cpu.note: fp32 CPU recomputation from cached final-norm inputs; 'share_residual_swap_under_instr_readout' is the CPU analogue of RS-fork(36); the two parts sum to 1 by construction
